profile_summary: Presales specialist covering a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator account, with six years across B2B sales, product delivery and technical operations in telecom, banking and retail. Strongest in the front half of a deal: running discovery with the customer, turning what they need into technical scope, and building the commercial case that moves a decision. Brought in GBP 350,000 of B2B pipeline at Apple and met 100 percent of a financial regulator's mandates inside a 14-day window at Bank of China. The pattern is the same everywhere: find the manual process, define the fix, get it adopted.

bullets: Took USD 2 of cost out of every unit by making the case across GTM roadmap and pricing reviews for dropping a feature the customer did not value.

Cut a daily manual check across 60 to 80 live sample units and about an hour a week of paperwork by writing VBA automation into the evaluation programme I own, swapping hand-tracked deadlines for scheduled reminders and template-generated sign-off.
Surfaced the requirements the bid was built on by running 3 technical workshops and one structured requirements session with the customer's engineering stakeholders.
De-risked what the proposal could promise by testing solution feasibility against 6 of the account's subnets before anything went to the customer, as presales cover inside a 5-person pursuit team.

Met 100 percent of the HKMA's regulatory mandates inside a hard 14-day window by turning the regulation into an implementation plan and coordinating internal teams with third-party vendors to ship Geo-IP fraud detection with impossible travel logic.
Handed back 8 hours a week of manual reporting across 20 systems, roughly 400 hours a year, by replacing hand-assembled weekly reports with a single Grafana observability view.
Got that framework adopted in one sitting by demoing it to 30+ system leads and two department heads and answering their technical objections live.

Ended a 3-year-old complaint about incident triage by specifying and validating a Python anomaly detection prototype, built with a developer, that told real incidents apart from deployment noise across 50,000+ operational logs.

Removed roughly 1,500 hours of manual work a year across 6 flagship sites by finding the 5-hour weekly data entry burden sitting at each one and replacing it with a self-sustaining reporting setup that gave regional directors live numbers instead of week-old ones.

Reversed a headquarters decision by showing the Shanghai development team evidence that store operations varied by location, moving the POS migration off centralised training and onto store-specific delivery.

Brought in GBP 350,000 of new B2B pipeline across a 50+ account portfolio by running discovery, solution positioning and qualification myself, then escalating matured accounts to the corporate team to close.

Closed a GBP 50,000 deal with a Hong Kong broadcaster over 3 months by turning a casual store visit into a real opportunity, earning trust through hands-on technical support and a custom pricing portal, then upselling device management once they raised fleet-control concerns.
